{{Top|leg}}
'''Drop Point: Gelgelar''' was an [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] [[drop point]] run by [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Arik Stijhl]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It was built within a warehouse leased from [[Slerog Fenn]] at the [[Gelgelar Free Port/Legends|Gelgelar Free Port]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the base was destroyed by the [[Doom Slayer]] [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droid]] after it was inadvertently brought to the drop point by [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[T'Charek Haathi]] and her [[T'Charek Haathi's Special Ops team|Special Ops team]] aboard a [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]] called [[The Maker (YT-1300 light freighter)|''The Maker'']].<ref name="DP">{{JournalCite|14|Special Ops: Drop Points}}</ref>
